parts:
The Henderson-Hasselbalch equation can provide the percent dissociation of a weak acid. When the pH is equal to pKa, the weak acid is which of the following?
W) 99% dissociated
X) 75% dissociated
Y) 50% dissociated
Z) 25% dissociated
